description: Storm Drain Inlets is a dataset listed in City of Los Angeles open data portal (data.lacity.org), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Los Angeles. Official Storm Drain System in the City of Los Angeles created and maintained by the Bureau of Engineering / GIS Mapping Division. GIS data contains the storm pipes and the storm drain inlets. Coverage: Los Angeles. The portal files it under the category City Infrastructure & Service Requests. Its tags are stormwater, geographic information, gis, inlets, storm drain. The table has 91 columns. Attribution on the portal: Bureau of Engineering. The portal shows 2024-11-29 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons 1.0 Universal (Public Domain Dedication). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-lacity-org-portal.
